check: F02 negative control: the release check's request capture on the published page and on the candidate
observed_by: Chrome's automatic favicon request appears in the page's Resource Timing entries, which the release check fails as a resource after the document; the server log shows it was answered 404. Playwright reports no page response event for a browser-made favicon request, so http_errors stays empty; WebKit made no favicon request. The candidate page, with its inline icon, made no request in either engine.

console_errors: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (File not found)

server: python -m http.server on 127.0.0.1, which answers /favicon.ico with 404 as GitHub Pages did
